mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_memory_episode WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM ai_memory_episode WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=#{request} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM ai_memory_episode WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND owner_id=#{user} AND domain=#{domain} AND session_id<=>#{session,jdbcType=VARBINARY} ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
SELECT FROM ai_memory_episode WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND share_scope_id=#{scope} AND status IN ('SHARE_PENDING','SHARED') ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_memory_episode SET status=#{status},revision=revision+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND id=#{row.id} AND revision=#{row.revision} AND status=#{row.status}

UPDATE ai_memory_episode SET status='SHARE_PENDING',revision=revision+1,share_scope_id=#{scope},share_owner_session_ref=#{ownerSession},shared_key_version=#{sealed.keyVersion},shared_payload=#{sealed.payload},shared_nonce=#{sealed.nonce},shared_tag=#{sealed.tag},shared_hmac=#{sealed.hmac} WHERE tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND id=#{row.id} AND status='CONFIRMED' AND revision=#{row.revision} AND share_scope_id IS NULL
UPDATE ai_memory_episode SET status='SHARED',revision=revision+1,share_approver_id=#{actor} WHERE tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND id=#{row.id} AND status='SHARE_PENDING' AND revision=#{row.revision}

UPDATE ai_memory_episode SET status='REVOKED',revision=revision+1,encrypted_payload=NULL,nonce=NULL,auth_tag=NULL,content_hmac=NULL,shared_payload=NULL,shared_nonce=NULL,shared_tag=NULL,shared_hmac=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND id=#{row.id} AND revision=#{row.revision} AND status<>'REVOKED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_memory_episode_like(tenant_id,episode_id,user_id) VALUES(#{tenant},#{episode},#{user}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id=user_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_memory_episode_like WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND episode_id=#{episode}
SELECT FROM ai_memory_promotion WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM ai_memory_promotion WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=#{request} FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.tenant_id,p.id,p.episode_id,p.owner_id,p.target_type,p.target_definition_id,p.target_version_id,p.candidate_digest,p.status,p.revision,p.request_id,p.fingerprint,p.regression_suite_id,p.regression_suite_version,p.regression_report_sha256,p.total_cases,p.passed_cases,p.regression_reviewer_id,p.publisher_id FROM ai_memory_promotion p JOIN ai_memory_episode e ON e.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND e.id=p.episode_id JOIN ai_memory_sharing_scope acl ON acl.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND acl.id=e.share_scope_id JOIN ai_memory_sharing_member m ON m.tenant_id=acl.tenant_id AND m.scope_id=acl.id AND m.user_id=#{user} WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND e.status='SHARED' AND e.expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND acl.status='ACTIVE' AND acl.expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND (p.owner_id=#{user} OR (#{canReview}=TRUE AND p.status='DRAFT' AND p.owner_id<>#{user}) OR (#{canPublish}=TRUE AND p.status='REGRESSION_PASSED' AND p.owner_id<>#{user} AND p.regression_reviewer_id<>#{user})) ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_memory_promotion SET status='REGRESSION_PASSED',revision=revision+1,regression_suite_id=#{command.suiteId},regression_suite_version=#{command.suiteVersion},regression_report_sha256=#{command.reportSha256},total_cases=#{command.totalCases},passed_cases=#{command.passedCases},regression_reviewer_id=#{actor} WHERE tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND id=#{row.id} AND revision=#{row.revision} AND status='DRAFT'

UPDATE ai_memory_promotion SET status=#{status},revision=revision+1,publisher_id=CASE WHEN #{status}='PUBLISHED' THEN #{actor} ELSE publisher_id END WHERE tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND id=#{row.id} AND revision=#{row.revision} AND status=#{row.status}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_memory_promotion WHERE target_version_id=#{version} AND target_type='PROMPT'target_type IN ('SKILL','WORKFLOW') FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_memory_episode e JOIN ai_memory_sharing_scope acl ON acl.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND acl.id=e.share_scope_id JOIN ai_memory_policy p ON p.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND p.id=e.policy_id AND p.current_version_id=e.policy_version_id WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND e.id=#{episode} AND e.status='SHARED' AND e.expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND acl.status='ACTIVE' AND acl.expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND p.enabled=TRUE AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_memory_dependency d WHERE d.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND d.target_type='EPISODE' AND d.target_id=e.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_memory_dependency d LEFT JOIN ai_memory_source s ON s.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND s.id=d.source_id WHERE d.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND d.target_type='EPISODE' AND d.target_id=e.id AND (s.id IS NULL OR s.retention_deadline IS NULL OR s.retention_deadline<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) OR s.grant_epoch<>d.grant_epoch OR s.source_epoch<>d.source_epoch OR s.deletion_epoch<>d.deletion_epoch OR OR (s.source_type IN ('MESSAGE','CURRENT_USER_MESSAGE') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_operation_message message JOIN ai_operation_conversation conversation ON conversation.id=message.conversation_id WHERE e.domain='operations' AND CAST(message.tenant_id AS BINARY)=e.tenant_id AND CAST(conversation.tenant_id AS BINARY)=e.tenant_id AND CAST(conversation.user_id AS BINARY)=e.owner_id AND CAST(conversation.id AS BINARY)=CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.scope_json,'$.session_id')) AS BINARY) AND CAST(message.id AS BINARY)=s.source_object_ref AND CAST(SHA2(CAST(message.content AS BINARY),256) AS BINARY)=s.source_version))))
